suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require PsA before a separately established depressive disorder; preserve that the cohort endpoint was treated depression. Population-level temporal association only; pain, disability, inflammation, treatment, sleep and psychosocial factors may mediate/confound. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Psoriatic Arthritis and Major Depressive Disorder
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus

suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment associated risk. Require PsA plus documented biologic/targeted immunosuppressive exposure (especially TNF-pathway agents where applicable) before TB infection/reactivation/disease. Treatment-associated TB risk; do not infer TB from PsA without immunosuppressive exposure and epidemiologic risk assessment. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment or procedure used for Psoriatic Arthritis
Independent diagnosis of Mycobacterium Tuberculosis and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and source-phenotype fit
